title: Command Palette Index Row
description: Per-row schema for the Cockpit Command Palette index. Rows are derived from the carried command inventory (COMMAND_INVENTORY.json) and the carried policy (COMMAND_EXPOSURE_POLICY.json). All fields are required. Missing values render as the literal string 'UNKNOWN' and trigger fail-closed routing to the Unknown/Drift Queue. The palette never invents values for missing fields and never silently substitutes defaults.
fail_closed_rule: If any field on this row resolves to 'UNKNOWN' and the operator selects an outcome that requires the field, the palette must not invoke the Safe Action Gate or Settings/Admin/Runtime; it must route the row to the Unknown/Drift Queue with the missing-field reason.

command_path.description: Fully qualified invocation path including subcommands, e.g. './scripts/dopetask doctor' or 'dopemux routing status'. Carried verbatim from the inventory.

parent_group.description: Top-level command group/family the row belongs to (e.g. 'dopetask', 'dopemux routing', 'dopemux mcp', 'mcp/servers'). Carried verbatim.

authority_domain.description: Authority domain that owns the row. The palette never substitutes its own authority. 'unknown / conflicting' triggers fail-closed routing.

canonical_writer.source: derived from authority_domain + system docs in docs/03-reference/systems/*
canonical_writer.description: System or service that owns the write/state mutation for this row. If multiple writers exist, all writers are listed comma-separated. Required so Safe Action Gate can show every writer for T2–T6 actions.

safe_ui_exposure.description: Safety class governing the row's allowed UI form. Drives outcome routing per PALETTE_ROUTING_RULES.md.

cockpit_placement.description: Carried Cockpit placement. Drives placement-axis routing in PALETTE_ROUTING_RULES.md §3.

current_cockpit_coverage.description: Carried coverage status. MISSING and UNKNOWN coverage are surfaced as filterable badges and feed the Unknown/Drift Queue when other fields also fail.

activation_status.description: Whether the runtime has the row registered. DEFINED_NOT_REGISTERED, OPTIONAL_IMPORT_UNKNOWN, and DEPRECATED_BLOCKED route the row to Unknown/Drift Queue per UNKNOWN_DRIFT_QUEUE_SPEC.md §1.

source_file.description: Absolute or repo-relative path to the source file that defines the row (e.g. 'src/dopemux/routing_cli.py').

source_symbol.description: Function, class, or registration symbol within source_file. Required for provenance, not for execution decisions.

help_text_or_summary.description: Short human-readable description from the row's --help text or docstring. Used for display only; never for executability decisions.

evidence_path_or_command.description: Path or command that produces evidence proving the row exists and works (e.g. an inspect command, a manifest entry). Required for provenance and for the Inspect outcome.

parameter_schema.source: derived from source_file/source_symbol parsing + carried inventory parameters
parameter_schema.description: Schema describing required and optional parameters, defaults made explicit, target types (path, service, remote endpoint, task id), and side-effect class per parameter.

required_parameters.description: Parameters that must be supplied; the palette refuses to invoke a gate if any value is unresolved or 'UNKNOWN'.

items.name: string
items.default: explicit value or null; never implicit

optional_parameters.description: Optional parameters with explicit defaults. No implicit defaults are permitted.

cwd_target.description: Working directory the palette resolves against. Must be the current worktree, never '/tmp' as authoritative.

output_target.description: File path, log target, dry-run output, or NOT_APPLICABLE.

side_effects.description: Enumerated side effects (config mutation, write local, write remote, start service, stop service, execution handoff, none).

proof_requirement.description: Required post-action proof category. Mapped from class to Safe Action Gate tier. Stale proof reroutes the row to the Unknown/Drift Queue.

gate_tier.description: Confirmation tier the row maps to. T0/T0i never invoke the gate; TX/TU never execute. T1–T6 require Safe Action Gate handoff.

allowed_palette_outcomes.description: Subset of outcomes the row may resolve to, given its class, placement, activation, and coverage. Always exactly one outcome at click; this list defines the candidate set.

blocked_reason.description: Human-readable reason a BLOCKED_IN_COCKPIT row is blocked, including replacement command (if any) and required external workflow. Required for any row where safe_ui_exposure = 'BLOCKED_IN_COCKPIT' or activation_status = 'DEPRECATED_BLOCKED'. 'NOT_APPLICABLE' for non-blocked rows.

unknown_reason.source: derived from authority_domain == 'unknown / conflicting' OR activation_status in {'DEFINED_NOT_REGISTERED','OPTIONAL_IMPORT_UNKNOWN'} OR safe_ui_exposure == 'UNKNOWN' OR current_cockpit_coverage in {'UNKNOWN','MISSING'}
unknown_reason.description: Reason the row is unknown or has drift. Required so Unknown/Drift Queue can show why and what investigation packet is needed. 'NOT_APPLICABLE' for rows that are fully resolved.

updated_at_or_source_timestamp.source: COMMAND_INVENTORY.json metadata or filesystem mtime of source_file
updated_at_or_source_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp indicating when the row was last sourced from the inventory or its source file. Stale entries beyond a configured window route to Unknown/Drift Queue with reason 'STALE_INDEX'.

row_validation_rules.rule: If safe_ui_exposure == 'UNKNOWN', allowed_palette_outcomes MUST be ['ShowUnknownDriftReason'] and gate_tier MUST be 'TU'.
If safe_ui_exposure == 'BLOCKED_IN_COCKPIT', allowed_palette_outcomes MUST be ['ShowBlockedReason'] and gate_tier MUST be 'TX'. blocked_reason MUST NOT be 'UNKNOWN'.
If safe_ui_exposure == 'EXTERNAL_ONLY', allowed_palette_outcomes MUST be ['CopyCommand'] (optionally with 'Inspect' for help text). gate_tier MUST be 'TX' or 'T0i' (no execution path).
If safe_ui_exposure == 'DISPLAY_ONLY', allowed_palette_outcomes MUST include 'Inspect' and MUST NOT include 'OpenSafeActionGate' or 'OpenSettingsAdminRuntime'. gate_tier MUST be 'T0'.
If safe_ui_exposure == 'INSPECT_ACTION', allowed_palette_outcomes MUST include 'Inspect' and MUST NOT include any executing outcome. gate_tier MUST be 'T0i'.

If safe_ui_exposure == 'CONFIRM_REQUIRED', the row MUST resolve to 'OpenSafeActionGate' (or 'OpenSettingsAdminRuntime' which itself invokes the gate). gate_tier MUST be one of T1–T6 based on side_effects. The palette MUST NOT auto-confirm.

If safe_ui_exposure == 'COMMAND_PALETTE_ONLY', the row MUST be reachable only via the palette and MUST NOT appear on a primary mode home screen via the palette. allowed_palette_outcomes MUST include 'Inspect' (parameter preview) and MAY include 'OpenSafeActionGate' or 'OpenSettingsAdminRuntime' depending on derived gate_tier.

If activation_status in {'DEFINED_NOT_REGISTERED','OPTIONAL_IMPORT_UNKNOWN','DEPRECATED_BLOCKED'}, allowed_palette_outcomes MUST be a subset of {'Inspect','ShowBlockedReason','ShowUnknownDriftReason','CopyCommand'} and the palette MUST NOT route to Safe Action Gate or Settings/Admin/Runtime.
If authority_domain == 'unknown / conflicting' OR canonical_writer == 'UNKNOWN', the row MUST route to Unknown/Drift Queue with unknown_reason set; no Safe Action Gate handoff is permitted.

If parameter_schema.required_parameters contains any value resolving to 'UNKNOWN' at preview time, the row MUST NOT be handed off to the Safe Action Gate. The palette routes to Unknown/Drift Queue with reason 'PARAM_UNRESOLVED'.

cockpit_placement is the placement axis for routing; the palette never relabels a row's home. If cockpit_placement == 'External/Not Cockpit', allowed_palette_outcomes MUST be a subset of {'Inspect','CopyCommand'} and gate_tier MUST be 'T0i' or 'TX'.

index_invariants: Every row in the index has every required field present; missing fields are stored as the literal string 'UNKNOWN', not null.

Counts of rows by safe_ui_exposure, placement, activation_status, coverage, and authority_domain MUST match the carried counts in COMMAND_EXPOSURE_POLICY.json:metadata.source_counts. The palette is a view, not a source of new counts.
No row may be assigned an authority_domain or canonical_writer not listed in the carried inputs.
No row may be reclassified inside the palette index. Reclassification requires a packet (UNKNOWN_DRIFT_QUEUE_SPEC.md §5).
